project_info.theme: YSL lipstick shade No 1966 beauty portrait
project_info.color_palette: Warm orange, deep brick red, platinum blonde, black, white

main_subject.detail: A glamorous beauty portrait of a platinum-blonde bob-haired model wearing dramatic brick-red lipstick. The lower-left text reads 'NO 1966' and 'ĐỎ GẠCH NÓNG BỎNG'. A YSL The Slim lipstick bullet stands beside the copy on the left. The background is a warm orange studio gradient.
main_subject.style: Luxury portrait beauty poster with fashion-editorial makeup focus

items: Top Left: Model's platinum bob and orange gradient background
Top Right: Smooth warm orange negative space
Bottom Left: YSL The Slim lipstick bullet and white shade-name typography
Bottom Right: Lower fade into dark gradient near the base of the portrait
Center/Background: Close beauty portrait with black manicure touching the neck and bold brick-red lips

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Velvety skin finish, subtle specular highlights, vivid lip color emphasis, fashion-beauty polish

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury beauty poster for YSL lipstick shade No 1966. Centerpiece is a glamorous photoreal portrait of a platinum-blonde bob-haired model wearing dramatic brick-red lipstick against a warm orange gradient. Include the exact text 'NO 1966' and 'ĐỎ GẠCH NÓNG BỎNG', plus a YSL The Slim lipstick bullet at the lower left. Technical style: photoreal beauty portrait advertising composite, soft luxury portrait lighting, velvety skin finish and vivid lip-color emphasis, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Beauty portrait model reference
assets.usage: Preserve the platinum bob, facial angle, black manicure, and overall glam expression

assets.name: YSL The Slim lipstick in shade No 1966
assets.usage: Match the slim black-and-gold bullet and the exposed brick-red shade

assets.name: Warm orange studio gradient
assets.usage: Maintain the clean, heated backdrop behind the portrait

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Keep the portrait elegant and editorial. The lipstick shade and the platinum bob are the two key fidelity anchors. Do not add extra props beyond the single lipstick bullet.
